digest.component_or_area: development-process audit evaluation and decision reconciliation
propositions: Six prior audit recommendations must be evaluated against prior audits, janitor remediations, architecture decisions, and implementation tickets to determine reaffirm/refine/reconsider/defer dispositions before proposing new work.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) has a prior implementation at 1.1% coverage via optional fail-open creation; proposal should expand automatic stamping at known filer/agent boundaries rather than adding required fields or backfilling unverifiable history.

Deterministic plan preflight has an existing P1-P11 floor; proposal should extend only for mechanically decidable failure classes with offline replay validation, explicit false-positive ceilings, and fail-open behavior, not for a second generic framework.

Completion-failure classification should be derived from historical sidecars (351 existing with 682 structured findings) offline before adding schema changes; proposed categories must be validated for stable inter-rater agreement and reliable automated derivation.

Risk-tiered review must account for the fact that this project has autonomous Gerrit review without routine human approval; pilot risk reporting and independent model/agent review without hard enforcement thresholds until prospective defect/revert data validates tiers.

Proactive debt management via 720-LOC warning and automated janitor already shipped; future work should prioritize only concrete clone families and call-graph seams where size intersects complexity/churn/defects, not arbitrary quota targets.
